tools.name: get_table
tools.description: Retrieve the official 2026/27 Premier League standings table with positions, points, goal difference, games played, and European qualification / relegation cutoff zones.

tools.name: get_predicted_lineup
tools.description: Get the verified predicted tactical Starting 11, formation, starting player names and positions, bench options, and AI Tactical Confidence rating for a Premier League club ahead of kickoff.

tools.name: get_all_lineups
tools.description: Retrieve the complete slate of all 20 Premier League predicted formations, starting XIs, and tactical confidence scores for the current gameweek.

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Retrieve live Premier League injury telemetry, medical room updates, chance of playing percentages, and press conference manager quotes. Can optionally be filtered by club.

club.description: Optional club name or slug to filter injuries (e.g. 'arsenal', 'chelsea')

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: List Premier League matchday calendar fixtures with local kickoff ISO dates, gameweek numbers, and home/away pairings. Can filter by gameweek number and/or club.

club.description: Optional club name to filter fixtures (e.g. 'liverpool')

tools.name: get_clubs
tools.description: List all 20 Premier League clubs with official managers, stadium names, capacities, primary club colors, and designated set-piece specialists (corners, free kicks, penalties).

tools.name: get_match_report
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive tactical match reports with official starting lineups, chronological event timelines (goals, cards, substitutions), xG, possession, and Touchline Wire lineup forecast accuracy.

club.description: Club name or slug to get the latest match for (e.g. 'arsenal', 'chelsea')

latest.description: Set to true to get the latest match across the entire Premier League

tools.name: get_set_piece_takers
tools.description: Retrieve the authoritative hierarchy of set-piece specialists for Premier League clubs: primary and backup penalty takers, direct free-kick takers, and corner specialists ordered by manager priority.

club.description: Optional Premier League club name or slug (e.g. 'arsenal', 'chelsea', 'liverpool'). If omitted, returns all 20 clubs.

tools.name: get_fixture_difficulty
tools.description: Retrieve upcoming Fixture Difficulty Ratings (FDR) ranking Premier League clubs by easiest to toughest schedule over upcoming matches (3 to 10 fixtures) with home/away difficulty tags (1=easiest, 5=hardest).

window.description: Number of upcoming matches to analyze (default: 5)

club.description: Filter schedule difficulty to a single club (e.g. 'arsenal')

tools.name: get_match_preview
tools.description: Retrieve pre-match tactical dossiers for upcoming fixtures: predicted formation clash (e.g. 4-3-3 vs 5-4-1), manager tactical records, expected starter matchups, medical availability, and 5-game form guide.
